title: Budget-matched multi-objective optimizer comparison for Symthaea casting research

run_design.objective_evaluation_accounting: Every objective-oracle call consumes one unit, including infeasible, invalid, timed-out, crashed, or otherwise failed evaluations. Candidate proposals and acquisition optimization are not objective evaluations; they are recorded in wall-clock and compute costs.
run_design.adaptivity: All seeds, budget points, target thresholds, reference points, metrics, and analysis rules must be frozen before examining algorithm results.

suites.reference_point_policy: Fixed per suite instance and shared by all algorithms; minimize both objectives. Never choose reference points per run or algorithm.
Use only the official suite's predeclared metric/reference convention or freeze a single documented per-instance reference before results; do not synthesize algorithm-specific reference points.
Freeze objective units/scales, feasibility rules, simulator revision and reference point before the first comparison. Synthetic and simulator-only results cannot be labelled physical validation.

baseline_lock.rule: This protocol is not execution-ready until every required baseline, suite adapter, and environment has immutable identifiers. Do not substitute 'latest' for a version.

primary_metric.definition: Area under hypervolume-versus-objective-evaluations curve, divided by the evaluation budget and by a frozen task-specific normalization constant. Freeze metric implementation, reference point, normalization constant and trapezoid/step convention in a hashed analysis lock before execution.

stretch_targets_not_current_results.note: Aspirational evaluation gates only. They are not current measured performance or a guarantee of superiority.

evidence_classes.synthetic: Known-answer stress tests; supports code-path and mechanism claims only.
evidence_classes.benchmark: Frozen public test suites; supports claims bounded to those suites and budgets.
evidence_classes.simulator: A specified simulator with frozen parameters; supports simulation claims only.
evidence_classes.physical: Held-out manufacturing observations with documented provenance and process coverage; required for real foundry performance claims.

publication_gate: Exact known-answer tests pass on the exact commit.
All required baseline and environment identifiers are hash locked.
The receipt validator passes for every run, and every run is accounted for, including failures and refusals.
The primary metric is recomputed independently from the raw trace.
No skipped, queued, incomplete, or missing run is reported as successful.
Per-task paired effects and uncertainty intervals are provided.
Synthetic, public benchmark, simulator, and physical findings are labelled separately.
